payload.title: Give local workers a configurable grace period
payload.description:
## Behavior and acceptance
Given a queued render, when a compatible local worker claims it within the configured grace period, then it renders using the open VideoML toolchain and no cloud render is submitted for that active lease. Report local selection and deadline in job status. Local compute avoids cloud rendering charges but still uses hardware/electricity and may use coordination/storage services.

## Ownership
Babulus rendering platform; VideoML public project/artifact contract

## Verification
Specify Given/When/Then fixtures before implementation and link results before closing. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.
